card.name: Just before epinephrine-type drug names
card.fires_on: Positions where epinephrine, norepinephrine or ephedrine is about to be written, such as the 'ad' in 'noradrenaline', or 'such as', 'e.g.,' and 'and' after pressor amines.

modes.label: Inside noradrenaline
modes.description: The 'ad' piece in 'noradrenaline' where the next piece is 'renaline'.

modes.label: Linking word before epinephrine
modes.description: A linking word or punctuation mark right before epinephrine, norepinephrine or ephedrine is named.

card.writes: It pushes the model toward continuing with 'ep' as the start of epinephrine or ephedrine.
card.plain: It fires where the text is about to name epinephrine, norepinephrine or ephedrine, often after 'pressor amines such as'.
